title_zh: 不绕行的AI城市 / INVARIANT CIVIC ROUTES
principle: AI may change services but may not force citizens to change their basic urban routes.

contracts.spatial_type: campus courts + research ground floors + lateral test pockets
contracts.route_invariant: work → meal/rest → green spine → public exchange remains available with testing and AI off
contracts.ai_sidecar: robotics/test interfaces stay in lateral pockets, service edges or replaceable nodes
contracts.human_equivalent: ordinary walking, rest, work and public exchange require no AI
contracts.proposed_accountable_role: campus public-space and test-management role — real actor to be confirmed
contracts.implementation_path: low-disturbance reversible actions first; project-dependent works require formal design/approval
contracts.acceptance_test: Switch testing/AI off: the same ordinary route still performs the daily chain without detour.
evidence_required: field survey of entrances and desire lines
safety review for any real test interface
contracts.reality_boundary: Concept route only; no test-lane width, bollard timing, speed or permit is claimed.

contracts.spatial_type: residential blocks + public ground floor + care court
contracts.route_invariant: home → shade/seating → care/human help → community living room remains account-free
contracts.ai_sidecar: opt-in navigation, service matching and care prompts attach to the route without becoming its gate
contracts.human_equivalent: human help and ordinary service entry remain available without login or personal-data consent
contracts.proposed_accountable_role: community service and care stewardship role — real actor to be confirmed
contracts.implementation_path: low-disturbance public-realm/service interfaces first; capacity and building works require formal project evidence
contracts.acceptance_test: Refuse login/data consent: the same physical route still reaches care, help and common life.
contracts.reality_boundary: No service radius, staffing level or response-time performance is claimed.

contracts.spatial_type: station-city hall + waiting commerce + heritage public edge
contracts.route_invariant: arrival edge → fixed wayfinding → human help → ordinary waiting/commerce → Jing-Zhang public interface remains usable without app/dynamic screens
contracts.ai_sidecar: dynamic information, translation and crowd guidance supplement fixed signs and human help
contracts.human_equivalent: fixed wayfinding and human help remain the baseline
contracts.proposed_accountable_role: station-city public-realm and wayfinding stewardship role — real actor to be confirmed
contracts.implementation_path: wayfinding/public-realm sample first; vertical circulation or station works only after real level/entrance/engineering evidence
contracts.acceptance_test: Turn off app/dynamic screens: a visitor can still find the way, ask for help, wait and leave on the same ordinary route.
evidence_required: verified station entrances and real level data
passenger-flow and ownership/operations evidence before engineering design
contracts.reality_boundary: PROV-KEY-003 has known absolute-location risk; no bridge, tunnel, station entrance, deck width or throughput is claimed.
